questions.prompt: A subnet is a network in its own right, with its own network and broadcast addresses.
Two hosts are on different subnets of the same company network. How does traffic get between them?
options: It can't: hosts on different subnets can never talk
Through a router (or firewall) that joins the subnets
Straight across the switch, since they belong to the same company

Which of these is NOT one of the three reasons for subnetting from the reading?
options: Giving every host a faster connection to the internet
